sources.leaguepedia: Leaguepedia Cargo API (lol.fandom.com): top-tier League of Legends events 2011–2026, champions, runners-up and their players
sources.compiled: Compiled from public records for this game (CS Majors, The International, VCT Masters / Champions, HLTV player of the year); not checked against a live source in this export
sources.leaguepedia_mvp: Leaguepedia Cargo API: MatchSchedule MVP of the last series between each LoL champion and runner-up (finals MVP)
sources.rosters_fix: Champion/runner-up rosters of more than nine names (merged stage records) removed; the teams are kept
sources.vlr.gg: vlr.gg event pages: VCT regional Challengers, international leagues, Kickoffs, Stages and LCQs 2021-2026 (champion, runner-up, event players)
sources.opendota: OpenDota: every premium league's final (last match), winner, runner-up and line-ups
sources.mpl: MPL Indonesia / Philippines official sites: every season's grand final and the finalists' season rosters
sources.bo3.gg: bo3.gg API: every finished S-tier CS tournament's final and line-ups

coverage: League of Legends: Worlds, MSI, First Stand, EWC, IEM and every top domestic league; CS: every Major and every S-tier tournament on bo3.gg; Dota 2: every TI and every premium event (Majors and more); VALORANT: Masters, Champions and every VCT league, Kickoff, Stage, Challengers and LCQ on vlr.gg; MLBB: every MPL Indonesia and MPL Philippines season. Not included: Honor of Kings (the game's HoK players are fictional) and Wild Rift.
